uutiset.t: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
uutiset.s: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

uutiset.t: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
uutiset.s: Nine people are dead in the attack, with rescue efforts ongoing to find those still missing from the residential building.

uutiset.t: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
uutiset.s: Democrats have now won at least 258 seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats.

uutiset.t: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
uutiset.s: In a statement to Italian media, his family remember him as "the greatest jeweller of our time".

uutiset.t: San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing
uutiset.s: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.

uutiset.t: Burnham to tell MPs 'landmark' EU deal could make next decade 'much better'
uutiset.s: The prime minister will tell MPs the deal agreed on Friday is a "choice between a broken status quo or change".

uutiset.s: The couple have been together for four years and were engaged in 2025.

uutiset.t: What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?

uutiset.t: US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order
uutiset.s: The Army says "swift action" is necessary to protect its personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant in Iowa.

uutiset.t: Mexican drug lord on FBI's 10 most wanted list arrested in shoot-out
